# close-book
Produces the quarter close book for finance.

import requests

ORDERS_URL = "https://orders.test"


def refresh_tiles(day):
    response = requests.get(ORDERS_URL + "/orders", params={"day": day}, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["items"]
